notes.title: So was gonna do an update one week after launch...
notes.notes:
But just like with the launch, why wait if it's done early?

Some bug fixes such as issues with names not showing up correctly for other players, Zombies not playing the correct animations when attacking and some issues related to respawning.

Added a credits screen to give credit to the artists who helped with this title.

Added a tips screen to help explain mechanics.

Added an achievements screen so you can check out what you've unlocked.

And speaking of achievements, added a dozen new achievements.

notes.title: Early Release!
notes.notes: Why wait when you can release a game early?  Come join the fun!
